message.content: Jennifer Moore provides several practical tips for managing muscle soreness after workouts. She emphasizes the importance of staying hydrated, suggesting that drinking plenty of water helps with recovery. Additionally, she recommends engaging in light activities like walking or gentle yoga, known as active recovery, which can help alleviate soreness. Jennifer also stresses the significance of stretching post-workout to improve flexibility and reduce tension in the muscles. For more targeted relief, she suggests using a foam roller on sore spots, noting that this can significantly help with muscle tightness. Lastly, Jennifer advises taking rest days to allow the muscles time to heal properly. These tips collectively aim to aid in recovery and promote overall well-being following strenuous exercise sessions.
